name: 13203 · Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13203 (Syracuse) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13203 (Syracuse) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13203 (Syracuse) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).
